eqs.range: Kilauea Iki tholeiitic glass saturated in olivine; MgO in wt%

eqs.name: Helz & Thornber (1987) CaO
eqs.range: Kilauea Iki glass saturated in olivine + augite + plagioclase; CaO in wt%

eqs.name: Montierth et al. (1995) MgO
eqs.range: Mauna Loa glass at 1 atm, 1110–1310 °C, with olivine ± plagioclase or pigeonite + augite + plagioclase; MgO in wt%

eqs.name: Shea et al. (2022) MgO
eqs.range: Hawaiian tholeiitic glass, 1060–1500 °C; MgO in wt%

eqs.name: Sugawara (2000) eq. 1
eqs.range: Olivine-saturated liquids at 0.1 MPa; MgO in mol%

eqs.name: Putirka (1999) eq. 3.8, clinopyroxene saturation
eqs.range: Clinopyroxene-saturated liquids to 100 kbar; Fm = FeO + MgO
eqs.code: (s, P) => { const l = s.Liq.p, fm = l.Fe + l.Mg; return 1e4 / (3.12 - 2.59e-2 * P - 0.37 * ln(l.Mg / fm) + 0.47 * ln(l.Ca * fm * l.Si ** 2) - 0.78 * ln(fm ** 2 * l.Si ** 2) - 0.34 * ln(l.Ca * l.Al ** 2 * l.Si)); }

eqs.name: Molina et al. (2015) amphibole saturation
eqs.range: Amphibole-saturated liquids; anhydrous cation fractions
eqs.code: (s) => { const l = s.Liq.p; return 107 * ln(l.Mg) - 108 * ln(l.Ca / (l.Ca + l.Al)) + 1184 + K; }

eqs.name: Kress & Carmichael (1991) melt fO2 from Fe3+/ΣFe
eqs.range: Natural silicate melts, 1200–1630 °C; requires measured Fe3+/ΣFe; ΔFMQ uses the FMQ buffer of Frost (1991)

eqs.name: Ryan et al. (1996) Ni-in-garnet
eqs.range: Peridotitic garnet; assumes constant Ni in olivine; Ni in ppm

eqs.name: Canil (1999) Ni-in-garnet
eqs.range: Peridotitic garnet; D = Ni(grt)/Ni(ol), olivine Ni assumed (default 3000 ppm)

eqs.name: Sudholz et al. (2021) Ni-in-garnet
eqs.range: Garnet peridotite, 1100–1325 °C experiments; olivine Ni assumed (default 3000 ppm)
eqs.code: (s, P, opt) => { const g = s.Grt; return -8254.568 / (g.XCa_FMC * 3.023 + g.XCr * 2.307 + ln(niGrt(s) / niOl(opt)) - 2.639) + 0.15; }
